newsitem.title: USA: JP Morgan plans to find replacement for Milano.
newsitem.headline: JP Morgan plans to find replacement for Milano.

text.p: J.P. Morgan & Co Inc unit JP Morgan Securities Inc said it plans to find a replacement for Steven Milano, who left to head Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc's municipal bond underwriting desk.
"While we have not filled the spot yet, we intend to replace him," a JP Morgan spokeswoman said Thursday. Milano was a vice president in the firm's underwriting group, she said.

Milano will start Monday at Lehman Brothers as a senior vice president, replacing Peter Coleman, who has been promoted to head the firm's commitment area, according to Stanley Ciemniecki, head of Lehman's municipal bond department.

Coleman's promotion fills a void left since May when Ciemniecki, who formerly headed the commitment area, was named head of the municipal department. Ciemniecki replaced D. Lee Hayes. Ciemniecki called Milano "a terrific addition" to the firm. "We are very pleased to have him on board," he said.
